messages:
jamie.ops: paging — Alerts: canary cluster showing 5xx spike after the 09:12 deploy. Error in logs: KMS decryption failed, AccessDenied. Canary health dropping to 35%. tagging @oncall.

pagerduty-bot: Incident created P0 -> oncall escalated to @sasha.dev (15s ago).

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026.03.15-09:12 to service/api-service completed. Canary traffic 10%.

sasha.dev: ack, looking. jamie can you paste the exact error lines? also any recent config or secret rotations this morning?

jamie.ops: logs from canary pods:
```
2026-03-15T09:14:07Z ERROR decrypt_secret: KMS.Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::111222333444:assumed-role/redwood-deploy/jenkins is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333444:key/abcd-rotated-2026
caused_by: key rotation completed at 2026-03-15T08:50:03Z
```

chandra.sre: that looks like the rotated key id. we rotated customer-managed key earlier this morning for compliance. suspect the service-account or deploy role didn't get updated IAM policy to allow the new key.

leo.prod: confirmed — deploy role policy still references old-key arn:...:key/abcd-old. I pulled the IAM diff, missing kms:Decrypt for new key.

sasha.dev: we need immediate mitigation: options: 1) rollback to previous deploy (old key in use), 2) trigger feature-flag kill-switch to stop the canary path that tries to decrypt (fast), 3) add kms:Decrypt to role (works but may take longer to propagate). preferences?

jamie.ops: we should flip the feature flag off for the new feature to stop decryption attempts in canary, then undo the rollout. flipping flag is fastest.

sasha.dev: doing flag kill-switch now -> using internal tool.

infra-bot: Executing: `flagctl set feature/new-inference-service enabled false --env=prod --scope=canary`

infra-bot: Result: OK — feature/new-inference-service disabled for canary group (0.9s).

jamie.ops: canary error rate dropping to 4% now. good. we're still seeing some residual 500s, likely from inflight requests.

sasha.dev: i'll start rollback to previous stable revision. tagging @chandra.sre to watch infra IAM changes in parallel.

sasha.dev: running: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/api-service --to-revision=127`

deploy-bot: Rollout undo started for deployment/api-service -> rolling back to revision 127.

chandra.sre: contacting infra-iam to update deploy role as a postmortem action. we should not rely on rollback as permanent fix. creating ticket INFRA-3291.

leo.prod: smoke checks on canary host c-34: `curl -sS -w "%{http_code}" -o /dev/null https://c-34.prod.internal/health` -> 200 after rollback.

jamie.ops: error budget trending back to normal across canaries. customer impact? we saw short-lived 503s for ~7 minutes. alert volume was ~120 requests failing, mostly internal canaries and a handful of production customers hitting the new path (estimated 8 customers saw errors).

sasha.dev: notes for incident summary: root cause = KMS key rotation executed earlier today; deploy role/pipeline not updated with iam:kms decrypt permission for new key id; rollout introduced code path that depends on decrypting feature config in-process causing canary failures.

sasha.dev: mitigation timeline: 09:12 deploy -> 09:14 errors observed -> 09:15 P0 paged -> 09:17 feature flag disabled for canary -> 09:19 rollback started -> 09:24 rollback finished and smoke checks passed -> 09:30 incident declared resolved (monitoring).

chandra.sre: follow-ups: (1) INFRA-3291 grant kms:Decrypt for arn:...:key/abcd-rotated-2026 to deploy role and pipeline service account, (2) add automated iam-check to deploy pipeline to validate kms key ARNs present in policy before rollout, (3) add a deploy step to avoid reading secrets/config that require KMS until after verification.

leo.prod: customer comms: small set of customers saw errors; SRE to draft notice for status page and CS to be ready for inbound tickets.

jamie.ops: opening postmortem doc and assigning action items. I'll @sasha.dev for write-up and @chandra.sre for remediation.

infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-3291 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-3291) assigned to chandra.sre.

pagerduty-bot: Incident P0 resolved and closed by sasha.dev (09:30).

sasha.dev: thanks all. handoff to next on-call for monitoring — @leo.prod you're up for the 10:00-14:00 shift, please keep an eye on any regression from key-policy changes.

leo.prod: on it, will watch dashboards and customer queue.

jamie.ops: updating runbook with the feature-flag kill-switch command and rollback playbook steps.

sasha.dev: postmortem to include timeline, root cause, and the 3 follow-ups from chandra. I'll draft and link to INFRA-3291.
